name: Notebuddy
tagline: One companion. A little care, every day.
description:
Raise one AI companion at a time. Feed, play, train and walk together, talk about your day, and keep an illustrated growth album. Your companion is randomly assigned one of 9 species and 8 elements. Start with a random appearance, or optionally use a photo or your own drawing as inspiration. Assigned species and element still shape the result; visual similarity is not guaranteed.

Walks hold up to 5 charges and recover one every 5 minutes, including time away. A walk can be quiet, award XP or lead to a monster encounter with a short 2D battle replay. Growth milestones are levels 1, 10, 30 and 50. Evolution automatically creates a personal portrait by extracting visual features from the previous appearance and generating a new image from those features.

Chat and successful care actions use your Anna AI allowance for replies. Optional artwork checking, portrait analysis and image generation also use allowance; analysis and generation are separate AI requests. Care is saved before its reaction, and AI dialogue cannot change rewards or stats. Failed AI requests may still use allowance. No external API key or ComfyUI installation is required.

English by default, with an optional Korean interface and AI replies. Progress, recent chat, artwork references, visual descriptions and saved portraits use Anna Persistent Storage. Daily quests reset at midnight Korea time (UTC+9). You can explicitly start over with a new random companion, clearing the previous progress, chat and portraits; reset and removal limitations are described in the privacy notice.
